faqs.question: Projector or large display: which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Displays are brighter and sharper in well-lit rooms, while projectors are more economical for very large screen sizes. We'll recommend based on room size and lighting.

faqs.question: Can you set up Microsoft Teams meeting rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes. As a Microsoft partner we can set up conferencing hardware that works smoothly with Microsoft Teams.

faqs.question: Do you handle mounting and cabling?
faqs.answer: Yes. We take care of wall or ceiling mounting, cable management and final testing.
